message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and I couldn’t help but chuckle at my gloriously over-prepared self. While others fumbled for their flashlights, I had my trusty lanterns ready to go, and I even had power banks charged up for our phones. It felt like a mini adventure as we played board games by lantern light, cozy and comfortable. It’s moments like these that remind me being prepared can turn an inconvenience into a fun family memory. How do you stay cozy when the lights go out?
